svg.text: NHE Pi 2x2 Audio: buffer board (one TL074)
High-impedance instrument inputs in front of the PCM1808, and a pad + buffer after the PCM5102. Single 12–18 V supply; VB is half of it.
TL074 A: input L (pins 1–3) · TL074 B: input R (pins 5–7) · guitar → this → ADC board L / R
TL074 C: output L (pins 8–10) · TL074 D: output R (pins 12–14) · DAC board L / R → this → pedals, amp
One supply for all four channels. Separate adapter from the Pi’s; grounds joined at one point (the ADC board’s GND).
TL074 pin 11 → GND. 100n from pin 4 to pin 11, right at the chip.
